descriptionText:
Giga builds AI agents for enterprise customer support and operations. Software engineers build and maintain the backend systems powering those agents, including data pipelines, integrations, and agent infrastructure, while shipping features and taking ownership of projects as they grow.
Responsibilities
You'll work across the backend, from data pipelines and integrations to agent infrastructure, shipping features alongside experienced engineers who will help you grow
We expect you to ramp up quickly, take ownership of your work, and operate with increasing independence as you learn the codebase
Atlas: Building features for our AI assistant: charts and alerts in Slack, natural language queries, and expanding Atlas to manage platform resources
Activity Stream: Log visualization with filters, timestamps, and frequency charts to give visibility into agent behavior
Dynamic knowledge: Adding time-based knowledge (like ongoing incidents) that auto-updates from sources like status pages
Agent memory: Conversation awareness and recent interaction lookups so agents remember context across sessions
As an early-career engineer, you'll be paired with senior engineers on larger initiatives while also owning smaller projects end-to-end as you ramp up
Skills
Have 1-3 years of professional software engineering experience
Are curious and ask good questions—you want to understand why things work, not just how
Can take feedback well and iterate quickly
Prefer shipping over perfection but still care about quality
Want to grow at a startup where you'll have real responsibility early
Benefits
Bonus
Equity
Catered lunch daily
Dinner stipend
$300/month wellness & commuter benefit (gym, fitness classes, mental health)
401(k) plan
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Company Overview
Giga provides an AI platform for voice and chat agents automating customer service and operational workflows with analytics. It was founded in 2024, and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA, with a workforce of 51-200 employees. Its website is https://giga.ai.
Company H1B Sponsorship
Giga has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships, with 8 in 2026. Please note that this does not guarantee sponsorship for this specific role.
